name: OmniRoute
description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 352 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 550+ contributors
one_liner: A free single connection point that automatically switches between hundreds of AI providers' free tiers, so a developer coding with AI tools rarely has to pay or hit a usage limit.
buyer: A cash-strapped indie developer or student who wants to use AI coding tools constantly but can't afford metered API bills, and needs the system to auto-switch providers when one runs out.
business_use_cases: A student or hobbyist developer runs it locally to code all day with AI assistants while spending close to $0 on API costs.
A small dev team self-hosts it internally to pool and manage multiple providers' free/paid quotas instead of buying redundant separate subscriptions.
A bootcamp recommends it to students so they can practice AI-assisted coding without needing to pay for API access.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, zero-setup version with a small markup over the free tiers for people who don't want to self-host.
Sell a 'pro' team dashboard with quota pooling and usage analytics across a whole company's seats.

steal_this: Spin up a hosted, one-click version of this (skip the self-host step) and charge a flat monthly fee cheaper than what people currently pay providers directly.
